sources.title: GitHub - google-deepmind/gemma: Gemma open-weight LLM library, from ...
sources.snippet: Gemma is a family of open-weights Large Language Model (LLM) by Google DeepMind, based on Gemini research and technology. This repository contains the implementation of the gemma PyPI package. A JAX library to use and fine-tune Gemma. For examples and use cases, see our documentation. Please report issues and feedback in our GitHub.
